_README: Named configurations offered as the product story. Every one is solver-validated against VEHICLE-ENVELOPES.json - none is asserted by hand. Run config_solver.py --validate-all to re-check.

configurations.name: Weekend Base
configurations.pitch: Cook and fresh water. The smallest setup that makes a vehicle self-sufficient for a night.

configurations.name: Trail Kitchen
configurations.pitch: Cook plus dry pantry. Food handling for a long weekend without a cooler.

configurations.name: Recovery Day
configurations.pitch: Pantry plus recovery gear. The setup for a day of driving rather than a night of camping.

configurations.name: Wash Up
configurations.pitch: Cook and sink. Needs 5th-gen 4Runner headroom or a van - the sink lid runs out of room in a 6th gen.

configurations.name: Basecamp
configurations.pitch: Cook, pantry, fridge and water. A van-class configuration - the fridge alone rules out every SUV bay measured so far.

configurations.name: Expedition
configurations.pitch: Cook, pantry, recovery, hot water and camp furniture. Five modules, van only.
